Carla Nguyen: small but urgent thread 9 AM UTC - payments fncall rejects spiked after canary. most routed to degen but console shows zero samples. anyone seen this? :thinking:
Ben Ortiz: region? model?
Carla Nguyen: eu-west1, t4-small-v2 hosted. logs: `validate_fncall missing required 'action.payload'` route=degen
Alice Park: did strict-validate-v2 rollout toggle today?
Carla Nguyen: yes around 09:12 UTC, canary -> partial rollout
Dan Li: found sampling bug: sampling job SQL filters `route='tool'` instead of `route='degen'`. samples not joining. opened PR #8214 to fix sampling join
Emily Reed: UX ask: surface reject reason and a short fix hint in the console route detail. customers ping why calls go to degen
Ben Ortiz: billing concern - are degen rejects being billed against committed Dedicated capacity?
Dan Li: metering pipeline currently drops `route_id` for validation rejects. created #8216 to stop dropping and preserve billing tags
Carla Nguyen: short-term mitigation idea: fallback that returns structured error with header `x-redwood-fn-reject: validation:action.payload` so caller can surface reason. thoughts?
Alice Park: fine by me. I'll add the header and a minimal error schema so SDKs can surfaces it programmatically
ops-bot: deployment: strict-validate-v2 canary -> hosts c-1702. status: 2/3 applied
Ben Ortiz: please post PRs + dashboard ticket links when ready. i'll loop in Billing if tags preserved
Dan Li: PRs: 8214 (sampling fix), 8216 (metering preserve route). dashboard ticket RD-1457 created for console fix
Carla Nguyen: sharing sample log
```
2026-01-12T09:12:33Z invoke_id=abc123 route=degen model=t4-small-v2 error=validate_fncall missing 'action.payload' quota_tag=dedicated-123
```
Emily Reed: filed product request: CONSOLE-2049 to show reject explanation + remediation steps in flyout
Ben Ortiz: setting watch on metrics; if reject rate >1% for 15m we revert canary :thumbsup:
Carla Nguyen: will report back in 1h with sample counts and if dashboard shows samples after PR merge.
